news.headline: Raiders TE Michael Mayer gets 3-year, $45M extension, sources say
news.description: Tight end Michael Mayer, who is stepping in for an injured Brock Bowers to start the regular season, has received a multiyear extension from the Raiders.

news.headline: Bucs' Egbuka 'full go,' McMillan doubtful for opener, says Bowles
news.description: Buccaneers coach Todd Bowles says wideout Emeka Egbuka will be "full go" for Sunday's opener against the Bengals, while fellow receiver Jalen McMillan is doubtful to play.

news.headline: Bears' Odunze feels 'ready' for Panthers despite questionable tag
news.description: Chicago Bears wide receiver Rome Odunze (calf) says he expects to play Sunday in the season opener at Carolina despite being listed as questionable on the final injury report.

news.headline: Seahawks confident in QB Drew Lock amid Sam Darnold's injury
news.description: Lock led Seattle to a Week 1 win after Darnold injured his hip and left the game. But can he keep it up against the Cardinals in Week 2 -- and potentially beyond?

news.headline: Sources: Lamar Jackson won't have deal before start of season
news.description: Lamar Jackson has been reluctant to discuss a long-term extension with the Ravens and has been more focused on the upcoming 2026 season, league sources told ESPN.

news.headline: Source: Jaguars, Parker Washington unlikely to agree to deal
news.description: The Jaguars and Parker Washington are unlikely to agree to a contract extension before the start of the season, a source told NFL Network.

news.headline: Sources: C.J. Stroud, Texans to table extension talks
news.description: The Texans and C.J. Stroud made a run at completing a contract extension before the regular season begins, but both sides agreed they now prefer to wait until after this season to work out a long-term deal, sources told ESPN and NFL Network.

news.headline: Sources: Packers, TE Tucker Kraft agree to 4-year extension
news.description: The Packers and tight end Tucker Kraft have reached agreement on a four-year extension worth up to $92 million, sources told ESPN.

news.headline: Sources: Bears, RB Swift agree to 3-year, $33.75M extension
news.description: The Bears and running back D'Andre Swift have reached an agreement on a three-year, $33.75 million extension that includes $27.5 million guaranteed, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

news.headline: Why Baker Mayfield's contract means the QB market could burst
news.description: Baker Mayfield just got $55 million per year in new money -- which is telling about where the QB market is headed. That's great news for 11 other passers ready for big deals.
